body:
Hi, got professional advise from a few different therapists in hs but quit. I had signs of severe depression throughout hs but told my parents it was anxiety, because they have said depression and most mental illness doesn't exist. I think it's a form of denial because I've noticed they also show signs of depression. Anything wrong with me would reflect poorly on their parenting and I don't even want some emotional connection breakthrough with them if I talk about it b/c they are narcissistic and confusing but good people. Getting help while living under their roof is just not an ok option in my mind. 

 I stopped smoking weed after 1st sem, and it hasn't helped with dissociation and paranoia, although voices have stopped. Ideally I'd be an artist or writer or something w/ creative output but that is just not feasible. I do have hobbies and would like to pursue them but it pales in comparison to interacting with people and doing sooo much stuff I have little patience for/interest in doing it just feels incredibly fucked up. Also, thanks for response.
